facts.value: You must have one set of official transcripts from every college and university from which you earned a bachelor's degree or higher sent to ASU.
If your school(s) cannot send them directly to ASU, you may send them yourself, making sure they meet specific requirements.

Original academic credentials issued by the registrar bearing the original raised or colored seal and signature, verified photocopies, or certified photocopies from a recognized international educational organization are acceptable.
Photocopies must be verified by a responsible official of the institution or by an education representative of the government/embassy.
All international transcripts must be submitted in the original language accompanied by an official English translation that is literal and complete.
Translations can be provided by the issuing university, an official translation service, the Ministry of Education, consulate, or embassy.
Translations certified by a notary public are not acceptable.
Current ASU students and alumni do not need to request official transcripts from ASU.
To expedite processing, write your application reference number on all documents and envelopes submitted to ASU.
Graduate Admission Services, Arizona State University, 1150 East University Drive Building C, Room 226, Tempe, AZ 85281.
